claims.claim: 6382 leaderboard records across 89 benchmarks are normalized into one (benchmark, model, harness, score) schema.
claims.metric: rows in data/clean/records.parquet after model and harness name reconciliation
claims.method: third-party leaderboard scores fetched from the Epoch AI Benchmarking Hub and the HAL leaderboards and normalized into one record schema; no evaluation is run by this project; model ids are canonicalized so the same model from two sources joins instead of forking
claims.repro: pip install -r requirements.txt && python src/fetch.py && python src/normalize.py && python src/views_harness.py

claims.claim: 41 models and 50 harnesses appear in at least one cross-harness matrix, over 10 benchmarks.
claims.metric: distinct models and harnesses on boards where a model was measured under 2 or more harnesses
claims.method: aggregation of published leaderboard scores (Epoch AI Benchmarking Hub, HAL): best published score per (model, harness) pair; no evaluation is run by this project; models measured under a single harness are excluded from the matrix
claims.repro: pip install -r requirements.txt && python src/fetch.py && python src/normalize.py && python src/views_harness.py

claims.claim: On Terminal-Bench, the median gap between a model's best and worst agent harness is 0.134 (score as a 0-1 rate), across 22 models measured under 3 or more harnesses.
claims.metric: median over models with 3+ harnesses of (best harness score - worst harness score) for that model
claims.method: aggregation of published leaderboard scores (Epoch AI Benchmarking Hub, HAL): best published score per (model, harness) pair; no evaluation is run by this project; models with fewer than 3 harnesses are excluded because a 2-harness gap is a single pairwise difference
claims.repro: pip install -r requirements.txt && python src/fetch.py && python src/normalize.py && python src/views_harness.py
